pages.title: Accessrank — ADA accessibility score & SEO for DTC ecommerce
pages.description: A low accessibility score is a lawsuit waiting to happen. Accessrank raises your ADA/WCAG 2.2 AA score with real code fixes, and lifts your SEO at the same time.

faq.a: No. Overlay widgets sit on top of your existing code without fixing it, and courts and regulators increasingly treat them as a red flag rather than a defense — 25% of accessibility lawsuits in 2024 involved sites running an overlay, and the FTC fined accessiBe $1 million in 2025 for misleading accessibility claims. Accessrank remediates the underlying HTML, CSS and ARIA in your theme instead of masking it with a script.

Most stores are live with a raised score in 2–4 weeks, depending on catalog size and how much custom code your theme carries. If you've already been served a demand letter or lawsuit, our express lane targets the cited and critical-path issues in about 7 days.

faq.q: Will this actually help my SEO?
faq.a: The same fixes that raise your accessibility score — alt text, heading structure, semantic HTML, ARIA labeling — are structural signals search engines read too. In a Semrush study of 847 sites, 73% saw organic-traffic growth after remediation (avg. +12%), and a larger 2025 Semrush study of 10,000 sites found higher-accessibility-score sites averaged 23% more organic traffic and 27% more ranking keywords. These results are correlational, not causal, and individual results vary.

WCAG 2.2 is the W3C's web accessibility standard: 86 success criteria organized under four principles — Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust (POUR). Level AA is the middle of three conformance levels and is the target referenced by ADA guidance, the European Accessibility Act, and Section 508. Level A alone isn't enough, and Level AAA is aspirational and largely unachievable for ecommerce content.

faq.q: Does the free check prove I am compliant?
faq.a: No, and be wary of any tool that claims it does. Automated testing — including our free check — catches roughly a third to a half of accessibility barriers. It's a fast way to surface obvious issues, but full WCAG conformance also requires manual testing with a keyboard and a screen reader, which is what our paid audits and remediation include.

faq.q: What if I have already received a demand letter?
faq.a: Talk to us right away. Our lawsuit-response engagement starts at $5,900, moves in about 7 days, and covers an emergency audit of the cited and critical-path barriers, source-code remediation of the complaint items, a screen-reader proof video, VPAT and conformance documentation, and a settlement-terms review. Accessrank is not a law firm and does not provide legal representation or advice — this runs alongside your attorney, not instead of one.
